brief.text: The Share an idea page of It's a Date (/share, logged in as Maya Chen): a 640px single-column form with photo drop zone and 4:3 preview, title (0/80), description (20-2000), tags 1-3, place type, budget and duration segmented controls, and 'Send for review'; States board behind a 'Show design states' toggle with field errors, uploading, upload failed, submitting, success and logged out.
assumptions: Logged in as Maya Chen; header from _shared/nav.html
Main view shows a filled-in form part way through (photo chosen, some fields filled)
States board is design-only, in a closed details toggle under the page
Tags, place types, budget and duration labels from packages/shared constants
The photo preview reuses a verified photo from content.md

tasks.name: Find an idea and the places near me
Check on an idea I shared

findings.fix: Keep "Your ideas" as it is on home, and mark [aria-current="page"] on "Share an idea" with a 2px --fg underline 6px below the text, the same as the active item in the category row.
findings.problem: "Your ideas" is coral and the current link "Share an idea" is plain dark text, so the link that looks active is the one for the other page.

findings.fix: Style .seg input:checked + span like a picked tag: --accent-soft fill, --accent-ink text at 600, a 1px --accent-ink border and a 14px check icon before the label. Keep the outer track as it is.
findings.problem: A picked tag is a coral-soft pill with a check, but a picked budget or duration is a solid espresso pill: two ways of saying selected, and the dark pill is heavier than Send for review.

findings.fix: Split it in two. Rejected file: empty drop zone with a message. Network failure: keep the faded preview and file name, add "pastry-walk.jpg didn't finish uploading." with a secondary "Try again" next to Remove.
findings.problem: One message covers both a rejected file and a dropped connection; it throws away the chosen photo and gives the wrong next step for a network failure.

findings.fix: While a field is invalid, put the error message in place of the helper text, on the same row with the counter on the right, and drop the extra muted line.
findings.where: board frame 1, field errors: Title and Description
findings.problem: Each invalid field shows the error line and then the normal hint and counter row as well, two lines saying nearly the same thing.

findings.fix: Design the Profile screen with the "Your ideas" tab showing this pending card, then re-run the task walk.
